capabilities: Render live stock, ETF, and crypto quotes inline from Yahoo Finance tickers
Compute expressions over quotes (+ - * / %, multiple tickers, parentheses)
Reference note and vault-wide frontmatter properties as @variables in expressions
Expose a JS API (getQuote, getQuotes, getHistory, onQuotes) for other plugins
Customize display with sign/decimal/currency modifiers, prefixes, and CSS classes
disambiguation: Not a charting or dashboard plugin; it renders inline values only and hands quote history to other plugins to draw.
extras: The Yahoo Finance endpoint is unofficial and may change or rate-limit; failed symbols show — instead of failing the note. Release assets carry artifact attestations and BRAT install is supported (dmgx0/obsidian-stonks). README warns about $: colliding with LaTeX $…$ math syntax.
problem: Obsidian has no way to show live market prices inline in notes or compute portfolio values against them without fixed block-based dashboards.

relations.evidence: Stonks fetches price quotes from Yahoo Finance (query1.finance.yahoo.com)
so all three can live in the same note without fighting over the same spans

summary: Inline finance quotes plugin that renders live stock, ETF, and crypto prices as inline code values with a small expression engine for portfolio math.
